source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U09: Identify unpaid-seller status and separate possession-based lien from stoppage in transit

payload.title: The location of goods determines which remedy to examine
payload.core_explanation_md:
Unpaid-seller status concerns the price and the legal payment arrangement. A dishonoured instrument accepted conditionally differs from an instrument taken as absolute payment. Once status is established,the remedy still depends on the transaction:retention while in possession is not the same as stopping goods already with a carrier.

The lien route has the described credit/insolvency conditions and can end through the specified delivery or waiver events. Stoppage requires the stated buyer-insolvency and transit facts. Obtaining a price decree does not by itself prove that the possession-based lien was waived. Trace price,payment terms,ownership,possession,carrier stage and insolvency separately.

self_check.prompt_text: Does every unpaid invoice automatically permit stoppage after the buyer already obtained delivery?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The transit and other conditions must still exist.

payload.stem_md: A seller calls a completed buyer delivery goods in transit solely because the price is unpaid. What fact is missing?

options.explanation_md: Preference does not undo completed delivery.

options.explanation_md: The source defines transit by actual events.

options.text_md: Whether the goods remain in the legally relevant transit stage
options.explanation_md: Unpaid status alone does not establish the remedy.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Unpaid status alone does not establish the remedy.

payload.stem_md: A credit sale term is still running and no other lien ground is established. The seller assumes nonpayment before maturity alone proves the stated lien right. What is required?

options.text_md: All credit terms can be ignored
Check the applicable lien ground,including credit expiry or insolvency
Every seller must surrender all rights permanently
A decree is automatically full payment
options.explanation_md: A judgment and satisfaction are different events.
